name: FloatingActionButton
summary: The one main action of a screen, floating above the content at the inline end and the block end. Icon only or extended with a label.
useWhen: A screen with one main action that must stay in reach while the content scrolls (create, compose)
Touch first layouts and phone screens
A canvas or a list where a toolbar would cover the content
avoidWhen: More than one main action on the screen
A form with a submit button at its end
Desktop layouts with a toolbar that already holds the action
On glass or over a floating bar

insteadUse.Submit a form: Button with tone accent and emphasis solid

icon.description: A system icon name or a node. Hidden from assistive tech.

label.description: The action, a verb plus a noun. The accessible name, and the visible text when extended.

extended.description: Shows the label beside the icon. Sets data-extended.

emphasis.description: Fixed: the main action is a solid fill. Not a prop.

tone.description: accent: the main action. Emphasis is always solid.

shape.description: default takes radius.control (Desk draws it as a pill), pill is fully round, square takes radius.sm.

position.description: fixed to the viewport; absolute in the nearest positioned container; static in the flow. Sets data-position.

a11y.focus: In the tab order where it sits in the DOM: render it after the content it acts on. The doubled focus ring.

keys.Tab: Moves focus to the next control

a11y.announce: The label is the accessible name in both forms.
notes: Floats at space.4xl from the inline end and the block end, plus the device safe area, on z.floating-panel.

Reserve room so it never covers focused content (WCAG 2.4.11): give the scroll container scroll-padding-block-end and padding-block-end of at least the button height plus its inset, and leave the last row clear.
Never under 44 by 44 CSS px (a touch first control).

en.label: A verb plus a noun: Create board, Write note.

ar.label: Noun form, no diacritics: إنشاء لوحة، كتابة ملاحظة.

angular.note: No asChild: the a form is the link. icon takes an icon name or a TemplateRef. Emphasis is always solid; size defaults to lg and does not take the size of a ButtonGroup, as in React.

native.note: Respects the safe area and the keyboard; 56pt is common on phones.

styles.studio: The neutral primary fill with an elevation.
styles.desk: Yellow, pill shaped, with an elevation.
styles.liquid: Never on glass: a solid fill over the content, never inside a floating glass bar.

mistakes.wrong: Two floating action buttons on one screen
mistakes.right: One; the other actions in a toolbar or a menu

mistakes.wrong: A floating button that covers the last list row
mistakes.right: scroll-padding-block-end and bottom padding on the scroll container

mistakes.wrong: An icon only floating button with no label
mistakes.right: label is required and names it
